findings.rootCause: LmdbBoundSimplifierOptimizer.meet(Filter) proved BOUND(?x) from filter.getArg().get(Assured)BindingNames() plus the root BindingSet names only, while its AbstractQueryModelVisitor descends into EXISTS/NOT EXISTS bodies (meetSubQueryValueOperator) and LATERAL right args where the outer row is substituted at evaluation time; a correlated name absent from the body's own patterns was folded to FALSE and the Filter replaced by EmptySet (EXISTS -> empty, NOT EXISTS -> spurious rows, LATERAL right arg -> empty).
findings.change: Introduced the shared correlation-aware scope analysis OuterScopeBindings.of(node, incomingNames) (roadmap 4.1) in core/queryalgebra/evaluation: it walks the parent chain at rewrite time (robust to in-place rewrites) and returns OuterScope(possible, possibleInScope, assured). Frames: EXISTS/SubQueryValueOperator body -> owning Filter arg / LeftJoin both args / Extension arg row (assured from the row the expression is evaluated on); LATERAL right arg -> left row restricted by Lateral.getRightInputBindingNames (assured = left assured ∩ right-input names); Join/LeftJoin right arg -> left names possible-in-scope only; MINUS right side -> executor-leak possible only (not in scope); sub-SELECT Projection/MultiProjection -> frames further out become leak-only and unassured; SERVICE/property paths block assurance; a scope-changing FILTER outside a subquery is never handed assured outer names (mirrors FilterIterator.filterScopeBindingNames); incoming bindings are assured at the root. LmdbBoundSimplifierOptimizer now unions outerScope.assured() into the assured set (BOUND -> TRUE only when the substitution is guaranteed) and outerScope.possibleInScope() into the possible set (BOUND -> FALSE only when the name is nowhere in scope). Sound: assured names may only enable, possible names may only block. Deviations from the design, all following the critique: (1) a third set possibleInScope so the sub-SELECT / MINUS barrier keeps today's spec-correct BOUND->FALSE fold instead of regressing to the executor's 3.4.3 leak (critique major); (2) rule (c) restricted to Join/LeftJoin, Difference leak-only, Union contributes nothing (critique minor); (3) LATERAL uses getRightInputBindingNames (critique minor).
testsAdded: OuterScopeBindingsTest (19 methods, one per frame kind: EXISTS owner Filter/LeftJoin condition/Extension, LATERAL right (restricted and default), Join/LeftJoin/Difference/Union right, sub-SELECT boundary, nested frames, scope-changing filters, root incoming)

findings.rootCause: LmdbFilterSimplifierOptimizer.optimize derived incomingBindingNames from the root BindingSet only and FilterMerger.meet(Filter) passed that set to LmdbNullRejectingOptionalSupport.rewrite, whose sole correlation guard (selectUnboundWitness) only rejected witnesses in that set. Inside an EXISTS / NOT EXISTS body or a LATERAL right arg the witness ?w of FILTER(?w = :c) over OPTIONAL { ?x :b ?w } is substituted from the outer row, so it is not unbound on unmatched OPTIONAL rows; the rewrite still turned the LeftJoin into a Join and the body then required a triple that does not exist (EXISTS -> false, NOT EXISTS -> spurious row, LATERAL -> empty).
findings.change: FilterMerger.meet(Filter) computes OuterScopeBindings.of(filter, incomingBindingNames).possible() once per Filter (after the in-place child-filter merge, before any rewrite) and passes it to LmdbNullRejectingOptionalSupport.rewrite instead of the root incoming set. The parameter was renamed incomingBindings -> outerVisibleBindings throughout LmdbNullRejectingOptionalSupport with javadoc stating the witness must be unbound in the enclosing evaluation context. The block-only direction uses the full possible() set (including executor leaks across sub-SELECT/MINUS), which is the conservative choice: any name an ancestor may substitute disqualifies the witness and the OPTIONAL survives. Uncorrelated witnesses (design control) are still rewritten as before.

findings.rootCause: LmdbFilterSimplifierOptimizer.makeOptionalBindingMandatory accepted Filter(LeftJoin(L,R), ?w = c) -> Join(L, Join(VALUES{w=c}, R)) whenever R's POSSIBLE binding names contained ?w and it received no outer/incoming names at all. When R may leave ?w unbound (nested scope group with an inner OPTIONAL, sub-SELECT not assuring ?w, UNION binding ?w in one branch) the VALUES anchor binds ?w=c on rows where the OPTIONAL had left it unbound, the retained filter passes, and a spurious row appears; when ?w is substituted from an enclosing EXISTS row (reached because barrierFreeSubtree makes the null-rejecting rule decline on the scope-changed group) the filter is a test on the outer value that an unmatched OPTIONAL row passes, so the rewrite dropped a valid row.
findings.change: makeOptionalBindingMandatory now requires the binding to be ASSURED by leftJoin.getRightArg() (getAssuredBindingNames, so nested groups / sub-SELECTs / one-branch UNIONs decline while all-branch UNIONs and StatementPatterns still rewrite) and not contained in the outer-visible set; the set is threaded from FilterMerger.meet(Filter) (the same OuterScopeBindings.possible() computed for 3.1.3) through rewriteSmallLiteralFilterAnchors and makeUnboundRejectingOptionalsMandatory. The guard sits before both the scoped-fanout hoist and the plain Join branches. Soundness: with ?w assured by R and not bound outside, every LeftJoin row either matched R (then the filter keeps it iff ?w=c, identical to the inner join) or is unmatched (then ?w is unbound, the filter rejects it, and the inner join produces nothing). Alias (directExtensionSourceAnchor) and hoist logic unchanged.

wp4/wp5 (execution, finding 3.4.3): the standard executor still pushes the outer row into sub-SELECTs, so the three sub-SELECT/MINUS spec controls in LmdbCorrelatedScopeRewriteTest (boundOfOuterNameInsideSubSelectIsFalseBySpec, ...WithinExistsIsFalseBySpec, boundOfOuterNameInsideMinusIsFalseBySpec) assert the LMDB pipeline only (checkLmdbOnly). Design deviations (critique-driven, see finding 3.1.1 change): OuterScope carries three sets (possible, possibleInScope, assured) instead of two; Join/LeftJoin-only correlation rule; MINUS leak-only; LATERAL restricted by getRightInputBindingNames.
